title: Which Way Is North
reference: repeat 5 { while not wall_ahead { forward } if facing_north { turn_right } else { turn_left } }
hints: Facing north at a wall? Turn right. Facing east? Turn left.
Walk to the wall, then ask the compass which way to turn. Loop it.
repeat 5 { while not wall_ahead { forward } if facing_north { turn_right } else { turn_left } }

story.intro: PATCH: "The Lantern Lab. See the compass on the floor? Ask it which way you face, and turn the right way every time."
